patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BigCommerce and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BigCommerce only if your buying job matches “Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($2” rather than Shopware's shape. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than BigCommerce's shape. Workflow advantage differs because BigCommerce is shaped for Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ( whereas Shopware is shaped for Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BigCommerce and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BigCommerce is Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($299); GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees; Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote..
- Researched limits: BigCommerce — 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription; Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV.

Limitations — BigCommerce: 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription; Native POS/retail depth trails Shopify/Square for omnichannel-first merchants; Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting.

Poor-fit cases: BigCommerce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription · Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Avoid BigCommerce if you actually need Shopware's motion (Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Ris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
